*F-obf* (Obfuscation, split VBB, iO) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: open — no accepted UC formulation exists yet.

*References:*

- Barak et al. [*On the (im)possibility of obfuscating programs*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2001/069). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2001, 2001.
- Canetti, Goldwasser, and Poburinnaya. [*Adaptively secure two-party computation from indistinguishability obfuscation*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2014/845). In 12th Theory of Cryptography Conference (TCC), Part II, pages 557–585, 2015.
